text_block_list.text:
Today is truly the grand premiere, a debut 
race worthy of the name!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A list of data analysis methods to 
understand my running...?

Actually, there's something I've been 
thinking about for a while now.
choice_data_list:
I want to deepen my understanding of how 
Cesario runs.

I want to deepen my understanding of 
Cesario's running.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: My running...?

A few weeks ago, I had consulted with 
several Trainers, including the 
exceptional rookie Trainer, Aoi Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "...I see. So to sum it upâ"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The "teachers" Cesario-san speaks of are 
the ones who taught her the fundamentals 
of running.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, any students she teaches in 
the future are likely to run in a style 
based on hers."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"In order to lead those future children to 
victory, I have to understand the running 
of the original 'Cesario' better than 
anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So, you wish to deepen your understanding 
of her running... is that correct?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I see. They really do end up looking 
alike. It happens all the time where you 
feel like you've seen someone's running 
form somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Form habits, running attitude, and 
sometimes, strangely enough, running 
styles too.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So the better we understand the "teacher," 
the more the students can grow, right?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Just how deep of an understanding are you 
expecting?

If it could lead to better guidance in the 
future, I was willing to do whatever it 
took.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I see. Thoroughly, then...
choice_data_list: So, I'd like to ask for everyone's help.

text_block_list.text:
I had listed every conceivable analytical 
method for the time being. However, it was 
still far from enough.
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry for the trouble, but thank you 
in advance!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Of course, we're in this together whenever 
someone needs help!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I had the chance to 
hear about the latest technology at a 
study group the other day—

And so, with the help of our colleagues, 
we were able to gather data collection 
methods and analysis techniques from all 
sorts of angles!

State-of-the-art wearable devices, AI data 
analysis, 2D and 3D motion tracking, 
nutritional analysis of meals—

"I sifted through the vast amount of 
information to find actionable ideas and 
prepared for our training."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And so... that's why there's this much.
choice_data_list:
I'd like to put this to use in our future 
training.

text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's assuming Cesario doesn't 
mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That is certainly a generous offer, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is... Must have been really, 
really tough..."
Was there something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, no. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing of great concern. Please do 
not worry yourself over it.

Is it out of consideration, or is it 
because I have yet to become someone 
worthy of her trust?

Feeling a touch of loneliness, I found 
myself unable to say anything more to keep 
the conversation going.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Here you are. A light meal.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
They were selling them outside. I thought 
you might be getting hungry around now. 
There's tea and a wet wipe inside too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't sure what your preferences were. 
I just hope it's to your liking.

Peering into the handed bag, I found just 
the right amount of delicious-looking 
snacks.
choice_data_list: No...! Sorry for making you worry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, I wanted to go for a short walk 
anyway, so it was just on my way.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I'm feeling kind of fidgety. After all, 
this is my long-awaited debut race.

She looked so calm and normal as usual 
that I didn't notice a thing...

"I'll be right beside you, so let's do our 
best together. Upon hearing those words—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah...
Her gentle expression suddenly tightened.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Indeed. If I were to act all restless...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That really braced my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Our ultimate aim is the Triple Tiara. We 
cannot afford to stumble here."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, one victory. And now, onto the 
trial race leading to the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, step by step. I must march 
forward into the future.
